articles.title: Pull Agoda hotel reviews with scores and sub-scores into a spreadsheet, in Python
articles.excerpt: If you manage a hotel, run a reputation-management tool or analyse a city's hotel market, Agoda is one of the review sources you can't skip in Asia. A single hotel page there mixes two review pools: r…
articles.body: If you manage a hotel, run a reputation-management tool or analyse a city's hotel market, Agoda is one of the review sources you can't skip in Asia. A single hotel page there mixes two review pools: reviews from Agoda's own guests and reviews from Booking.com guests that Agoda republishes. Each pool has its own score, its own review count and its own six sub-scores (cleanliness, facilities, location, room comfort, service, value for money). Reading that by hand works for one property. For a competitive set of 20 hotels, checked every morning, it doesn't. This post pulls the reviews and scores into a CSV in Python and shows a daily "new reviews only" setup. Disclosure: I'm Aurelix, and I built Agoda API , an Agoda reviews scraper. It's a paid tool (prices below).
articles.author: Aurelix Solutions

articles.title: The Physical Nightmare of On-Device AI: Why Your LLM Fails on a Custom PCB
articles.excerpt: In 2026, the hottest buzzword in the tech world is undoubtedly "On-Device AI." From Apple Intelligence to the flood of AI PCs and AI smartphones hitting the market, the entire software industry is rac…
articles.body: In 2026, the hottest buzzword in the tech world is undoubtedly "On-Device AI." From Apple Intelligence to the flood of AI PCs and AI smartphones hitting the market, the entire software industry is racing to cram large language models (LLMs) and vision models—previously running in the cloud—into portable devices weighing just a few dozen grams. As a software engineer, you might have fine-tuned models on a workstation with a dedicated GPU or run flawless inference in the cloud. But when your team moves to mass production and deploys the model onto a custom PCBA (Printed Circuit Board Assembly) you designed yourselves, the nightmare begins.

articles.title: Tokenization: BPE from Scratch, Vocab Size, and What Tokenizers Hide
articles.excerpt: Tokenization: BPE from Scratch, Vocab Size, and What Tokenizers Hide Before a language model reads a single word, a tokenizer has already decided how that word gets cut up. The model never sees letter…
articles.body: Tokenization: BPE from Scratch, Vocab Size, and What Tokenizers Hide Before a language model reads a single word, a tokenizer has already decided how that word gets cut up. The model never sees letters. It never sees words either. It sees token IDs, numbers drawn from a fixed list, and everything the model can and cannot do starts with that list. We built byte pair encoding from scratch, trained it on 83,159 real words from our own published articles, and measured it against OpenAI's real tokenizers. The headline numbers: the same sentence costs 16 tokens in English and 60 in Urdu, a vocabulary stops paying for itself after about 5,000 merges, and the number 2026 is two tokens because the tokenizer chops digits into groups of three.
articles.author: Muhammad Saud

articles.body: Darwin-180B-RSI-R3: Open-Weight MoE Scores #2 on SuperCLUE Math & Science Reasoning, Beating Gemini and Grok TL;DR: Darwin-180B-RSI-R3 is a 180-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model from VIDRAFT that scored 73.68 on the SuperCLUE November 2026 math and science reasoning dimension — ranking #2 overall and #1 among open-weight models on an independently administered, non-public test. It activates only ~3B parameters per token, ships weights under a Qwen community license permitting commercial use, and has a 4-bit quantized variant that runs on a 32 GB RAM laptop without a GPU. What it is Darwin-180B-RSI-R3 is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model built on top of Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next as a base.

articles.title: How to plan an infrastructure task without losing your mind: a breakdown using an AWS deployment as an example
articles.excerpt: The ticket fits on one line: "deploy a new web service to AWS and add jobs to deploy it." Inside that line are a network, containers, a database, secrets, a CDN, two workflows and dozens of small step…
articles.body: The ticket fits on one line: "deploy a new web service to AWS and add jobs to deploy it." Inside that line are a network, containers, a database, secrets, a CDN, two workflows and dozens of small steps that an engineer usually keeps in their head. That works while nothing interrupts you. Then you join a call, come back, and can't remember whether you checked the security group. And when someone asks how long it will take, the honest answer is "a day or two." I've been building IT infrastructure for about 15 years, and today I lead a DevOps team at a game studio. Tasks like "spin up a new service" or "change system X" land on my desk every week, and over the years I've settled into a fairly stable way of planning them. I tried to write that method down and then give it to an agent. Part 1.
articles.author: Sergey Byvshev

articles.title: Win32 app isolation needs a capability budget, not a one-time switch
articles.excerpt: Win32 app isolation needs a capability budget, not a one-time switch Win32 app isolation adds a sandbox to Windows applications that were not built as packaged store apps. The feature is available in…
articles.body: Win32 app isolation needs a capability budget, not a one-time switch Win32 app isolation adds a sandbox to Windows applications that were not built as packaged store apps. The feature is available in Windows 11 version 24H2 and later according to Microsoft's documentation. It can reduce the damage a compromised desktop application can cause, but the value depends on the capabilities the application is granted and the resources it can reach. The sandbox is a set of decisions Microsoft describes Win32 app isolation as a security feature that integrates a sandbox environment into Win32 apps. The application still runs as a Windows process, but its access to files, devices, and other resources is mediated through capabilities and the isolation model.
articles.author: facilishz

Static AI Block is a gallery of copy-paste blocks: ask this page, summarize, translate, FAQ bot, draft a reply, rewrite, extract to JSON, smart search, alt text for images, a quiz from the page, and an Explain button for code. Each block is plain HTML and vanilla JavaScript, 40–60 lines, no framework, no build step. Live gallery (every block runs right there): https://aiblock.onetagai.com/?ref=devto Repo (MIT): https://github.com/fengyiqicoder/static-ai-block How it works: the block loads one script tag from OneTag AI and calls onetag.ask(prompt, input) from the browser.

articles.body: Some science fiction franchises are so ambitious they become their own cinematic languages. Star Wars built an entire galaxy with a mythology that’s still growing almost 50 years later, while Blade Runner helped define the vision of a far-future Los Angeles through rampant tech advancement and unchecked capitalism. They’re the kinds of franchises that can change the way we imagine the future, influencing everything from fashion and technology to the stories other filmmakers want to tell. articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 8, 2005: Europe launches Venus Express, its first mission to Venus
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. Here's why Venus Express mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. The spacecraft was called Venus Express. Venus is a hothouse planet, one where the atmospheric pressure can easily crush an unprotected spacecraft. Even from orbit, Venus Express had to survive harsh radiation. But the spacecraft lasted for more than nine years. During that time, Venus Express saw a weird vortex swirling around Venus's south pole . It also saw possible signs of active volcanoes . Venus Express also discovered that the planet generates its own auroras . These auroras happen when particles from the sun hit charged particles in the atmosphere. Late in the Venus Express mission, controllers told the spacecraft to dip down into Venus's clouds — even though the spacecraft wasn't designed to do this.

articles.title: Who is King Ghidorah? The cosmic connections of Godzilla Minus Zero's foe
articles.excerpt: Godzilla will go toe-to-toe with long-time foe King Ghidorah in Godzilla Minus Zero. This three-headed Kaiju's origins aren't just space-based; one of the largest structures in the universe shares its…
articles.body: Godzilla goes toe-to-toe with long-time foe King Ghidorah in Godzilla Minus Zero, which opened in theaters on Friday (Nov. 6). Though the three-headed golden Kaiju might seem like a natural native of Monster Island, King Ghidorah actually emerged from the depths of space. However, it isn't just the origins of King Ghidorah — also known as Monster Zero in the Godzilla movie Invasion of Astro-Monster (1965) — that are this beast's only cosmic connection. One of the largest structures in the universe, the King Ghidorah Supercluster , was named in honor of Godzilla's primary antagonist. Eat that, King Kong!
articles.author: Robert Lea

articles.title: Everyone wants an electric pickup truck. I want more electric 125cc motorcycles
articles.excerpt: If you follow the EV industry in North America, you’d be forgiven for thinking that the future of transportation revolves around electric SUVs and pickups. Every week seems to bring another teaser fro…
articles.body: If you follow the EV industry in North America, you’d be forgiven for thinking that the future of transportation revolves around electric SUVs and pickups. Every week seems to bring another teaser from a startup promising to reinvent the family car or truck. The latest electric SUVs, “coming soon” tiny trucks, lifestyle trucks, modular trucks, etc. Companies like Slate, TELO, and countless others have generated plenty of excitement, even if many of them still have everything left to prove. Don’t get me wrong – I hope they succeed. We need more affordable electric vehicles.
articles.author: Micah Toll
